cards.persona: An engineer who heard of Spindle and lands on the home page; wants to try it today and to know whether it is released.
twists: reads the landing page first and expects the install command one click away
asks for a version: the site states the release state in one place only

cards.persona: A developer with an ESS specification who wants it served over HTTP on their laptop, and must write the environment for it.
twists: scans for HTTP, a word the navigation does not carry
knows the term environment document from the README, not where the site defines it

cards.persona: An operator who arrived on the rally example from a link and wants to know what a served run exposes for observation.
twists: starts deep in the site, on the rally page, not on the landing page
the answer is a flag row in the generated CLI reference, while the Observe concept page carries the word

cards.persona: An integrator whose approvals live in their own HTTP service, back after wave 18 shipped outbound HTTP calls and the topology of an observed run.
twists: scans for HTTP, which the sidebar carries only in the R-00 link to serving over HTTP; the call is a section of Environment and admission
starts on the Observe concept page, whose one mention of topology is a screen of the fixture UI; the answer is a clause of the --observe row of the generated CLI reference

cards.persona: An operator on a phone, mid-incident, who has the getting-started page open and needs the size of the request log an observed run keeps.
twists: reads on a 390 px screen, where a reference table shows its first columns only
scans for request records, words of the answer cell, before the flag name --observe-requests

rotation: R-00 rotated R00-operator in, R-01 R01-caller, R-02 R02-phone-operator. A rotated-out card keeps its tasks as regression scenarios of the ratchet.
